title: Agentic Clinical AI: governed agentic AI for clinical data surveillance and enrollment forecasting
description:
A reproducible Snakemake reference pipeline in which two AI agents (clinical data surveillance and predictive enrollment intelligence) act on statistical findings through a shared governance runtime: least-privilege identities, risk-tiered tools gated by autonomy level, a human approval queue, input screening, PII redaction, a circuit breaker, a hash-chained audit log, an oversight meta-agent and institutional memory of human decisions.

Site risk is scored with credibility-weighted robust z-scores and an Isolation Forest; country enrollment is forecast with a Poisson-Gamma Monte Carlo model. The system is evaluated on synthetic multi-country trials with injected ground-truth problems. All data are synthetic.

This is a reference implementation and not a validated GxP system. It implements principles described in the Syneos Health white paper 'Understanding Agentic AI in Clinical Development - From Automation to Autonomy: Part 1' (2026); it is independent and not affiliated with or endorsed by Syneos Health. The software was developed with the assistance of an AI model (Claude, Anthropic) under the author's direction.
